recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17594; any future move from primary/secondary example procedure type codes to different claim-submission concepts should proceed through FHIR-31039 or a terminology proposal.
issue_request: FHIR-17594 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested a type sub-element on Claim.procedure, modeled like diagnosis.type, with procedure ranking concepts in the value set. The Jira comment explicitly said to also apply the change to ExplanationOfBenefit.
initial_application: Commit afb5ec66f68641293bb7950b6e0eeb118fa1444a explicitly listed 17594 in a broad Claim batch and added Claim.procedure.type with the ProcedureType binding and example procedure-type terminology. Commit 09259975771dffe6419b6a1293fa8f3b9232ac6d then enabled ExplanationOfBenefit.procedure.type. Later source conversion commits preserved those spreadsheet rows in the current StructureDefinition XML, and the 2020 UTG migration removed the core CodeSystem source while retaining the core ValueSet binding to the THO code system.
additional_context: Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The current combined branch contains both requested procedure.type elements as repeating CodeableConcepts bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/ex-procedure-type. Later FHIR-53057, already represented on the combined branch, explains the current preferred binding strength. FHIR-31039 asks to replace the procedure-type example code system, but it remains Triaged and unresolved, so it is not an approved terminology edit for this seed.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit StructureDefinitions already satisfy the structural request, and changing procedure-type code semantics would be governed by unresolved FHIR-31039 rather than by FHIR-17594.
